findings.summary: crates/server/src/access.rs: the Access key refresh job only logs; no metric for its rate, errors or duration, so a Cloudflare certs outage (every request 401, pod still Ready) has nothing to alert on.
findings.reason: Access::read_keys now counts each read (periodic and on an unknown key) through Metrics::observe as source access_keys: board_source_reads_total, board_source_read_errors_total and board_source_read_duration_seconds. Tested by key_reads_are_counted_and_a_failed_one_is_an_error.

findings.summary: crates/app/src/main.rs: no automated test covers the native app sending CF-Access-Client-Id/Secret; with only one of the two env vars set it silently sent no token.
findings.reason: The half-set case is now an error shown in the app ('set both … or neither'). The headers themselves are checked end to end in Verify; main.rs has no test seam.

findings.reason: The web build is served on routes "/" and "/{*file}", so its requests and refusals are counted under those.
